## Goal
Deterministic validation of extracted receipts and a rule-based review status.

**Depends on:** F02 (parallel with F03, F07)
**Built by:** `backend-dev`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Table-driven tests cover each rule in `backend/domain-logic.md`
- [ ] The review status is never shown as a number
- [ ] `app/domain/` imports nothing from `db`, `ai` or `api`
